★ D-PP-PRAGMA-RECOGNIZED-SEMANTICS — `#pragma once` runtime witness. Until 2026-08-29 DSS did not merely IGNORE the pragma: `applyPragma`'s `IncludeOnce` arm REFUSED THE TRANSLATION UNIT (`P_PreprocessorPragma`, exit 1), so every real-world header using the commonest guard idiom failed to compile — against an idiom gcc, clang and MSVC all accept. ✔MEASURED through the CLI at 94971261 on a two-line `#include "h.h"` twice. So this program DID NOT COMPILE BEFORE, and that is the witness: there is no wrong-answer arm, because a refused pragma is a hard error rather than a miscompile.
★ EVERY HEADER DEFINES A FUNCTION, WHICH IS WHAT MAKES THIS A WITNESS RATHER THAN A RESTATEMENT. If any dedup fails, that header's `int once_X_value(void) { ... }` is DEFINED TWICE and the build fails loudly. A header carrying only `#define`s would be re-splicable with no observable consequence and would prove nothing.
★ THE SPELLINGS ARE THE POINT — the operator ruled 2026-08-28 that the key is IDENTITY, NOT CONTENT, so every spelling of one file must reduce to one key. This TU reaches `once_a.h` FIVE ways (directly; transitively through `once_b.h`; as `./once_a.h`; as `sub/../once_a.h`; and as `../once_a.h` from inside `sub/once_d.h`) and `once_c.h` / `sub/once_d.h` twice each. A path-STRING key splices `once_a.h` five times and the build dies on the first duplicate. ⚠ Note the SIBLING shape: the second arrival is never a cycle, so the pre-existing include-stack cycle guard could not and did not catch it — which is precisely why this row's defect survived that guard.
★ FOUR FORMS, ONE ADDEND EACH, so a gap in any single one takes the whole program down rather than hiding behind the others. FORM 1 (`once_a.h`) the bare idiom, pragma on line 1, NO macro guard — MEASURED as 18 of the 21 macOS 26 SDK headers that carry `#pragma once` (all of AppleArchive/*). FORM 2 (`once_b.h`) a once-header that itself includes another. FORM 3 (`once_c.h`) the pragma inside a TAKEN conditional, which must FIRE — the live twin of the dead-branch case the unit suite pins, since `#pragma once` inside `#if 0` must NOT fire and all four references agree on both halves. FORM 4 (`sub/once_d.h`) a subdirectory header reached under two spellings whose own include of the parent uses a `../` walk. 10+11+9+12 = 42, with each addend also checked individually so a compensating pair cannot reach 42 by accident.
★ REFERENCE GROUND TRUTH, not DSS's opinion — ✔MEASURED 2026-08-29, each reference invoked SEPARATELY, `-std=c17 -Wall -Wextra`, ZERO diagnostics from all three, each built binary run: WSL gcc 13.3.0 exit 42, WSL clang 18.1.3 exit 42, mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 exit 42. The `release` arm runs the shipped parser->semantic->codegen->native pipeline over the same source, so it also witnesses that the optimizer does not disturb the deduped splice.
